description: The connected Instagram Business account’s own recent media — id, caption, media type (feed / reel / story-era), permalink, timestamp, like and comment counts. This is where the media id every other Instagram tool needs comes from: resolve “my latest reel” yourself instead of asking the user for a link, then pass the id to meta_post_insights. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: which Instagram account — an @handle or id from list_connector_accounts("instagram"). Needed when several are linked, and the way an Instagram Login (standalone) account is reached; omit for the one Page-linked account.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

pageId.description: Facebook Page id — omit when only one Page is connected

name: list_instagram_media
title: List the brand’s Instagram posts
